title: Glowing Mushrooms
description:
Glowing Mushrooms can be found in caves, below the surface and without sky access. They are used to craft Luminous Powder .

They give off light and slowly spread to nearby dark spots on grass, dirt, stone, Fertilized Dirt or mycelium, as long as there are fewer than 5 of them close by. A Glowing Mushroom breaks and drops itself if its light level gets too high.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Found in caves (world generation); drops itself when broken

properties.label: Config
properties.value: GlowingMushrooms (worldgen), default true - turns world generation off
